description: This file defines template classes for IPC (Inter-Process Communication) channels, including client and server types, with methods for managing connections, factories, and message invocation. It also includes mechanisms for handling socket states and client management within a namespace.

classes.name: IPCChannelClientType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPC client channel, supporting connection management, factory creation/destruction, and state handling.

classes.name: IPCChannelServerType
classes.description: Template class representing an IPC server channel, managing client connections, message invocation, and factory lifecycle.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the IPC channel or socket with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the IPC channel or socket with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel or socket is currently open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel or socket is currently closed.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for a specified element type with an initial size.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Destroys the factory for a specified element type.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a command on the client or server with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up client connections, closing and removing closed clients.
